author: jalmena
tagline: Because "I think it was smaller" is not data.
description:
Self-hosted longitudinal tracking of your moles and skin marks: register them on a body map, photograph them
periodically against a physical reference, measure them with their uncertainty, compare observations over time
and take a report to your dermatologist. Your photographs never leave your server.

neVus is a personal documentation and measurement aid. It does not diagnose, screen for, or assess the risk of
any disease.

tips.before_install:
Set PUID and PGID to the owner of /DATA/AppData/nevus/data. For live camera capture and installation as an
app on your phone, serve neVus over HTTPS through your reverse proxy; uploading photos from the native camera
works over plain HTTP.

title: neVus
release_note:
1.7.0: a new body map with smooth outlines, limbs in bands you can name, heels and ears to tap, and
landmarks to help place a mark; your own anatomy drawn if you set it in the profile; every page redesigned,
with a mark's visits on a time line; a shorter report; and a larger neVus mark on the 3D-printable card,
with a grey square printed by a filament change.
1.6.0: neVus speaks nineteen languages, from Spanish and Catalan to Japanese and Arabic, across the interface,
the notifications, the reports and the printable card, whose sheet and print note come in your language. The
3D-printable card gains rounded corners, a frame line, a larger neVus mark and spare grey squares to glue on.
1.5.2: the printable reference card ships as one STL per piece, the right way up, with the neVus lockup
raised on it and the height at which to change colour in its note.
1.5.1: a photo taken with the reference card shows the mark itself, cut from inside the card's window, in
every list, on the visit and in the lightbox, with the card and the original a tap away; two card photos
compare lined up on the mark, inside the window. Glare on the mark is flagged as a quality note. The card
can be printed in three dimensions, in two colours or in white with a marker. Reports show the mark large,
without the card, and keep to what the clinician needs. Hands and feet tell palms from backs, and the
selected zone is named. Marks on a body map with dated looks and scrubbed photographs; measurement against
the card or a coin with its uncertainty; comparison views and PDF reports; reminders by email, webhook,
calendar feed or push notification; full-body sessions; a second factor, encrypted backups and a trash.
English, Spanish and Portuguese. Photos from earlier versions get the mark's crop by themselves after
the upgrade.
